Where it began

Jamie Overton was born in Barnstaple on 10 April 1994. He has a twin brother, Craig, who also became a Somerset cricketer, so there was rarely a shortage of someone to bowl at in the nets.

Jamie first played for Somerset in a 40-over match against Surrey in 2012. That same year he caught the eye at the Under-19 World Cup in Townsville, where he tore into Australia in the opening game at speeds near 93 mph. Both of the top-order batsmen he removed were caught at slip by Craig, which kept the credit nicely in the family.

The player

He is a right-arm fast bowler and a hard-hitting right-handed batsman. In 2020 he made his first first-class hundred during the Bob Willis Trophy, and that year he moved from Somerset to Surrey, where he was part of the side that won the County Championship in 2022.

England picked him for the third and final Test against New Zealand in June 2022, and he made his debut on 23 June. In his 2 Tests, played between 2022 and 2025, he scored 106 runs at 35.33 with a top score of 97, the kind of innings that is thrilling and agonising in about equal measure. He also took four wickets and held two catches.

What made him special

Pace was always the calling card. When the England and Wales Cricket Board began tracking bowling speeds in the first-class game in 2022, Overton was clocked at 90 mph. Add the batting and you have the sort of cricketer captains love: someone who can change a match in either half of it.

That all-round worth showed in The Hundred, where he was named player of the tournament for Manchester Originals in 2023 after strong displays with bat and ball. If his Test wickets came at a steady rather than spectacular rate, his 97 suggested the batting could more than make up for it.

Away from the middle

His skills have taken him around the cricket world. He played the Big Bash for the Adelaide Strikers, who signed him again in 2024 as a platinum pick, and in November 2024 the Chennai Super Kings bought him for the 2025 season of the Indian Premier League. In 2023 Surrey signed him to a new contract, a thank-you for everything he had given the club since arriving.

And finally

Few cricketers can say their first big moment on the world stage was set up by their twin. It is the sort of help a brother never lets you forget.
